title: Cy Twombly

description.main: Catalogue of Cy Twombly's 2002 exhibition at Inverleith House, Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh.
description.extended:
The catalogue of Cy Twombly's 2002 exhibition at Inverleith House, in the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh, gathers the sculptures, flower photographs, and works on paper he showed there around a botanical theme.

The book reproduces recent plaster and bronze sculptures, one of them polychrome, with colour photographs of tulips and peonies and large-scale works on paper. Colour plates and details of the exhibited works are followed by photographs of the installation. Mark Francis contributes a short text, and Patricia Waters a poem on the brief beauty of a rose. Bruce Mau Design designed the cloth-bound volume, which Browne of Toronto printed for Gagosian. The cover carries the exhibition's title and place in red script on grey cloth.

Gagosian notes that the botanical subject was unusual in Twombly's earlier work, and that the garden and library at Inverleith House suited the exhibition. His flower photographs are reproduced at greater length in Schirmer/Mosel's Photographs III 1951–2010.

notes: Catalogue of the 2002 exhibition at Inverleith House, Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh. Cloth hardcover, printed by Browne of Toronto.
